# Parse, Don't Pray: The Case for Data Validation

> A Quarto RevealJS presentation by Indrajeet Patil.

Explore the benefits of Pydantic and Zod for runtime validation, type safety, focused contract testing, and safer input boundaries. The deck uses current Pydantic 2 and Zod 4 APIs and distinguishes validation from authorization and transport-level protections.
